name: LD士多
author: FluxDO 社区
summary: 原生商城、订单、消息与求购洽谈，支持后台提醒和证据附件。
description: 整卡进入商城，固定搜索与分类，查看商品图文、卖家与购买条件；通过 Connect 和 LDC 收银台完成授权与付款确认，管理订单、券、收藏、评论和售后。已有求购会话支持历史分页、发送和关联订单。系统消息可筛选、标记已读并跳转关联页面。预览为模拟数据，包含图片失败占位。
changelog: 整理商品评论区：统计与评论内容分区留白，无评论时使用独立空态，首次加载显示骨架；翻页加载、错误重试与更多评论不再同时出现，已加载评论保持可见。优化回复间距，评论关闭或没有下一页时停止翻页。

en.name: LD Store
en.summary: Browse products, sign in, confirm orders, pay with LDC and view delivery details.
en.description: Browse products, sign in, confirm orders, pay with LDC and view delivery details.
en.changelog: Separate review statistics from comments with consistent spacing. Empty reviews use a dedicated empty state and initial loading uses skeletons. Pagination, retry and load-more controls now appear one at a time while existing comments stay visible. Improve reply spacing and stop pagination when comments are closed or no pages remain.
